description: Unified 14-subcommand CLI for all gpts_core operations. Provides a single entry point (gpts-core) that dispatches to all modules: signal analysis, metric classification, record validation, claim classification, evidence scoring, ledger replay, SEAL audit, promotion, manifest building, adjudication, coherence passport, claim auditing, report scoring, and spectral gap.
function: Unified 14-subcommand CLI for all gpts_core operations

inputs.name: argv
inputs.description: Command-line argument list passed to main(); None uses sys.argv

inputs.name: subcommand
inputs.description: One of: analyze-signal, classify-metric, validate-records, classify-claim, evidence-score, replay-ledger, seal-audit, promote, build-manifest, adjudicate, coherence-passport, audit-claim, score-report, spectral-gap

outputs.name: exit_code
outputs.description: 0 on success, 2 on error or gate failure, 1 on ledger/seal failure

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: JSON output (or Markdown if --markdown) written to stdout

public_api.name: build_parser
public_api.description: Build and return the full argument parser with all 14 subcommands registered.

public_api.name: main
public_api.description: Parse argv (or sys.argv), dispatch to the appropriate subcommand handler, return exit code. Catches all exceptions and prints ERROR to stderr.

subcommands.name: analyze-signal
subcommands.description: Compute structure metrics for a CSV signal column

subcommands.name: classify-metric
subcommands.description: Classify a metric row (name, value, context, row_type)

subcommands.name: validate-records
subcommands.description: Validate a JSONL file of raw output records

subcommands.name: classify-claim
subcommands.description: Classify a claim text as BLOCKED/BOUNDED/UNKNOWN

subcommands.name: evidence-score
subcommands.description: Compute evidence score from gate counts

subcommands.name: replay-ledger
subcommands.description: Replay a JSONL event ledger (hash chain check)

subcommands.name: promote
subcommands.description: Evaluate promotion candidates from CSV matrices

subcommands.name: build-manifest
subcommands.description: Build file manifest for a directory

subcommands.name: coherence-passport
subcommands.description: Build and validate a coherence passport

subcommands.name: audit-claim
subcommands.description: Audit a text claim against a corpus (7-section report)

subcommands.name: score-report
subcommands.description: Score a canonical audit report markdown

subcommands.name: spectral-gap
subcommands.description: Compute Ulam spectral gap over an alpha grid
